item.description:
Added

  • Notifications for Bromehew's activity, each kind with its own switch in Settings › General › Notifications: new updates found in the background (once per version), what automatic updates installed or left for you, and problems: Homebrew that cannot be checked or updated, and services that start failing. A click opens the matching section. They come from the menu bar app, so they also arrive when the main window is closed.

Added

  • Automatic updates: Bromehew can install Homebrew updates once a day in the background (Settings › General). The menu bar app runs them; pinned packages, apps that update themselves and apps that are open are left alone, no password is ever asked for, and a notification reports anything that needs you. The log is in ~/Library/Logs/Bromehew. After updating, Bromehew asks once whether to turn them on; they are off until then.

Added

  • Privacy policy in English and German, in the app (About Bromehew › Privacy Policy and the Help menu) and on appnoe.de ([#5](https://github.com/appnoe/bromehew/issues/5)).
